knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Unknown contents mean the unknown stream. The item is held and referred, not put in ordinary waste.
Ownership, permission and destination are the records that show a lawful removal is planned.
Destinations follow the plan and local rules, not general practice or convenience.

practicalCriteria: In a training scenario, the learner sorts ten mock items into the five streams and writes the destination for each.
The learner records the owner, permission and destination for one retained mock item.
passRule: Knowledge checks only: three of three correct is a reading pass. It is not practical competence. Practical sign-off: an assessor observes each practical criterion and records it as met or not met.
evidenceRequired: Knowledge-check result recorded by the assessor
Completed training worksheet or role-play record for the scenario, marked by a trainer
stopWorkCriteria: An unknown or leaking container is placed in general waste.
Property is removed with no recorded owner or permission.
